text: The test opens the search menulist, waits for its actual menupopup, finds OtherHeader within that popup and uses activateItem. It waits for the same popup to hide before awaiting the Custom Headers dialog callback. That callback checks one added header with the exact X-Foo label. Keep these direct test assertions and event ordering separate from the author's headless-success report or an unverified off-screen-click cause.
title: The Custom Headers test activates an item in its owned popup before waiting for the dialog
